# Current pricing

All amounts in US dollars, excluding taxes. Plan descriptions: [plan tiers](plan-tiers.md). Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Monthly prices
Starter 19 per month. Team 59 per month. Enterprise is quoted.

## Annual prices
Starter 190 per year. Team 590 per year. This is the annual discount in [discounts](../policies/discounts.md). Billing details: [invoicing](../processes/invoicing.md).

## Taxes
Prices exclude sales tax and VAT, which are added at checkout where required.
